title: Protecting the Logo
slide_intent: Teach designers to measure clear space from a feature of the artwork. A proportional unit keeps the separation meaningful as the mark changes size.
strategic_value: The lab can retain an identifiable silhouette in crowded layouts by deriving the exclusion zone from its own letterforms.
demonstration: A boundary surrounds the color mark. Blue markers indicate the height of the uppercase I on each side, and blue hatching fills the surrounding field.
practical_value: Use the height of the I to set the minimum separation around the logo when placing adjacent content.

content_islands.name: Rule
content_islands.spec: Explain the exclusion zone and its unit in the left rail.

content_islands.name: Clear-space drawing
content_islands.spec: Center the mark inside a bounded pale rectangle. Repeat the blue unit on all four edges and hatch the outer field to distinguish it from the clear space.
